title: Daniel Eugene Rupert | Obituaries | dnronline.com
text:
Daniel Eugene Rupert, 56, of Mount Solon, Virginia, passed away on Sunday, August 16, 2026, at Augusta Medical Center in Fishersville.
Mr. Rupert was born February 23, 1970, in Binghamton, New York, and was the son of the late Fred Eugene, Jr. and Betty Lorene Ingraham Rupert. In addition to his parents, he was preceded in death by a brother, Michael Rupert.
Daniel was a man who found joy in the simple things in life. He was an avid outdoorsman who loved to hunt and fish, always happiest when he was outside enjoying the beauty of God’s creation. He also had a deep love for his Dallas Cowboys and could often be found cheering them on win or lose. Daniel will be remembered for the things he loved, the memories he made, and the people whose lives he touched. His family will cherish the moments spent together, the stories shared, and the memories that will continue to live on in their hearts. Though he is no longer with us, his legacy will remain through the family and loved ones he leaves behind.
Surviving are a daughter, Danielle Showalter and husband, Wesley of Fulks Run; a son, Ryan Burke and wife, Alyssa of Grottoes; a sister, Wendy D’Andrea and husband, Raymond of Falling Water, West Virginia; five grandchildren, Brayson Showalter, Scarlett Showalter, and Kaiden Showalter of Fulks Run, Skylar Burke, and Sage Burke of Grottoes; nieces and nephews, Lauren, Darren, Madison, Ariana, and Caydence of Falling Waters, West Virginia, and Jessica of Harrisonburg; former spouse, Bonnie Simmons and caregiver, Richard Bates both of Mount Solon.
A funeral service will be conducted at 2 p.m., Thursday, August 20, 2026, at Gospel Hill Mennonite Church in Fulks Run with Pastor Dan Horning officiating. Interment will follow in the church cemetery.
The family will receive friends from 6 to 8 p.m. Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at the church.
Memorial contributions may be made to Muscular Dystrophy Association by visiting https://giving.mda.org/
Condolences may be shared at kygers.com.
